items.title: Verizon Stock Rises After Earnings as Turnaround Plan Gathers Pace
items.summary: Verizon  stock jumped after the wireless carrier reported better-than-expected earnings and raised its guidance, signaling to investors that CEO Dan Schulman’s overhaul is starting to pay off.  Verizon reported second-quarter adjusted earnings of $1.30 a share, as revenue slipped 0.7% from a year ago to $34.3 billion.  The telecommunications company also raised its full-year guidance.
